title: Fast Relax-and-Round Unit Commitment with Topological Constraints
summary: Recent developments in the US knowledge economy have created a significant growth in datacenter loads, with two major consequences for power generation. First, to compensate for growth in load, datacenters are encouraged to bring their own generating units. Second, in search of the remaining pools of dispatchable generation, utilities are increasingly turning to subtransmission and distribution level generating assets.
